risk_register.description: Delay in receiving production API credentials from the third‑party payment vendor, blocking backend integration and making it the critical path item for release
risk_register.mitigation_suggestion: Escalate to vendor account manager, request expedited credentials, and establish a fallback integration path

risk_register.description: Staging environment instability blocking QA regression testing for three consecutive days
risk_register.mitigation_suggestion: File an infrastructure ticket, set up monitoring, and coordinate with ops to stabilize the environment

risk_register.description: Chosen UI component library may not fully meet accessibility requirements, potentially requiring a mid‑project replacement
risk_register.mitigation_suggestion: Evaluate alternative UI libraries, conduct an accessibility audit, and plan for replacement if necessary
